question: Within a radius of 110 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI to Piano Craft Gallery, Boston, MA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Piano Craft Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Boston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 110000 ) );
